nodes.name: era5_config.yaml
nodes.summary: Master wind-analysis configuration for the ERA5 pipeline: CDS API settings, variables to download, wind-shear bounds, QC thresholds, Weibull fitting method, industry loss factors, P50/P75/P90 exceedance scenarios, and revenue assumptions (tariff and the canonical 333.79 LKR/USD FX rate).

nodes.name: era5_request_kalpitiya.yaml
nodes.summary: ERA5 retrieval request for the DutchBay/Kalpitiya site (turbine-array centroid, 2005-2024 fixed reproducible window, IEA Reference 10MW turbine, 15 turbines at 150m hub). Defines the long-term P50 baseline download without storing CDS credentials.

nodes.name: gis_export_dutchbay.yaml
nodes.summary: GIS export configuration consumed by analytics.gis.gis_export.run_gis_export to produce DutchBay WS150/CF/AEP GeoTIFFs at coarse (native ERA5 ~0.25 degree) and fine (downscaled ~0.05 degree) grids, with CRS, output paths, site centroid, and the 2020-2024 snapshot window.

nodes.name: locations.yaml
nodes.summary: Catalog of pre-defined Sri Lankan wind-farm sites (DutchBay, Mannar, Hambantota) with latitude/longitude, hub height, turbine count, and commissioning metadata for easy reuse across wind-resource analyses.

nodes.name: power_curves.yaml
nodes.summary: Library of wind-turbine power curves (wind speed vs kW output) for candidate turbines including Envision EN-171/6.5, Vestas V150-5.6, GE Cypress 5.5, and IEA/DTU/NREL 10MW reference machines, used to convert wind-speed distributions into energy yield for AEP estimation.
